description: Recent completed SV deployments/releases from sv_operations_calendar (operation_type in deploy|release|upgrade), cross-referenced with github_releases when the title names a SemVer-looking tag. Canton-specific. Use to answer "what shipped on MainNet recently?".

limit.description: How many deployments to return, newest first. Default 10, max 50.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

name: get_recent_deployments
